_comment: LM98C Gold Bot tactic library (SAMPLE/template). Research-only definitions of known XAUUSD tactics. status=research_only means NOT used by demo/live execution. replay_mapping.status: mapped=tied to an existing replay setup tag; research_only/not_implemented_yet=no feature yet. Copy to data/gold_bot/tactics/tactic_library.manual.json to customize (gitignored). No orders, no live.

tactics.name: Liquidity Sweep + Reclaim
tactics.description: Price sweeps a prior swing low/high then reclaims the level, trapping breakout traders.
tactics.entry_logic_summary: Enter on reclaim candle after a sweep of the prior session/swing extreme.
tactics.invalidation_summary: Close back beyond the swept extreme.
tactics.target_summary: Opposite liquidity / prior range mid to extreme.

tactics.name: Breakout + Retest
tactics.description: Range/level breakout that retests the broken level before continuation.
tactics.entry_logic_summary: Enter on the retest hold of a broken level in the breakout direction.
tactics.invalidation_summary: Retest fails and price closes back inside the range.
tactics.target_summary: Measured move of the broken range.

tactics.name: FVG Retest (filtered)
tactics.description: Fair-value-gap retest after a displacement leg, with extra confluence filters.
tactics.entry_logic_summary: Enter on the retest of an untapped FVG in the displacement direction.
tactics.invalidation_summary: Full fill + close through the gap.

replay_mapping.note: maps to fvg_retest; extra filters not yet in replay

tactics.name: NY Open Momentum
tactics.description: Momentum continuation around the New York session open.
tactics.entry_logic_summary: Enter with the dominant momentum leg after NY open expansion.

replay_mapping.note: maps to momentum setup (session filter approximate)

tactics.name: Scalp Momentum
tactics.description: Fast momentum scalp on M1/M5 with tight SL/TP.
tactics.entry_logic_summary: Enter on a fast momentum impulse with micro-confirmation.
tactics.invalidation_summary: Impulse fails within a few bars.

tactics.name: Scalp Retest
tactics.description: Micro pullback/retest scalp in scalp mode.
tactics.entry_logic_summary: Enter on a micro pullback hold after a scalp impulse.

tactics.name: EMA Trend Pullback
tactics.description: Pullback to a moving-average in an established trend.
tactics.entry_logic_summary: Buy/sell the pullback into the EMA in trend direction.

replay_mapping.note: no EMA feature in replay yet

tactics.name: VWAP Reclaim
tactics.description: Reclaim of session VWAP after a stretch away from it.
tactics.entry_logic_summary: Enter on reclaim of VWAP back toward value.

replay_mapping.note: no VWAP feature in replay yet

tactics.name: Asia Range Breakout
tactics.description: Breakout of the Asia session range into London.
tactics.entry_logic_summary: Enter the break of the Asia high/low at London open.

tactics.name: London Sweep Reversal
tactics.description: London sweep of Asia liquidity then reversal (judas swing).
tactics.entry_logic_summary: Fade the London sweep of the Asia extreme on reclaim.

replay_mapping.note: partially overlaps liquidity_sweep_reclaim; session-specific variant not isolated yet

tactics.name: ATR Expansion Breakout
tactics.description: Breakout confirmed by an ATR/volatility expansion.
tactics.entry_logic_summary: Enter the breakout when ATR expands beyond a threshold.

tactics.name: Mean Reversion at Extreme
tactics.description: Fade an over-extended move at a statistical extreme.
tactics.entry_logic_summary: Fade exhaustion at a band/extreme back toward the mean.
